propositions: A sticky gate-status strip must display all three gate verdicts (PLAN, COMPLETION, CODE) simultaneously with magnitude counts and anchor links to their respective detail sections.
Detail sections must render in fixed order (plan → completion → code) regardless of which gates pass or fail, preserving spatial memory for auditors.
Plan-review findings must expand in place to expose four-pass provenance (Finding / Verification / Decision / Coaching), while code-review findings degrade gracefully to render only available fields.

A threshold meter must render as a bar filled to priority with a tick mark at the finding's own resolved block_threshold, with fill color derived from the decision series (blocking / advisory / dropped / indeterminate).
Convergence visualization must adapt to round count: stacked bars for ≤3 rounds, line graph for ≥4 rounds (one polyline per non-empty decision series, not per round), with screen-reader data tables.
Round navigation must support independent query params (?plan_round=n, ?code_round=n) with server-side clamping, defaulting to the latest round (1-based index into newest-first lists).
